title: Agent liveness
responsibility: Determines whether an agent finished, lost its process, exceeded its heartbeat allowance or is still working.

inputs.name: agentLiveness.agent
inputs.description: Supplies the registration and heartbeat facts used to classify an agent. A final status takes precedence; otherwise the heartbeat time, TTL, PID and process start time determine liveness, while registeredAt is part of the type but is not read here.

inputs.name: agentLiveness.now
inputs.description: The assessment time in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Staleness is true only when now minus Date.parse(heartbeatAt) is greater than ttlSeconds multiplied by 1000; the timestamp is used without validation.

inputs.name: agentLiveness.processOf
inputs.description: Looks up the process ID named by an unfinished agent with a non-null PID. An absent process marks the agent gone; PID reuse is detected only when both start-time strings are non-null and unequal, and an undefined exists value alone does neither.

outputs.name: agentLiveness
outputs.description: Returns completed or failed from a final record, gone for a detected ended or reused process, stale only when heartbeat age exceeds the TTL, or working otherwise. The detail is generated for the selected branch; an unparsable heartbeat does not satisfy the stale comparison.

examples.detail: Its process 4182 ended without saying it finished
No heartbeat since 2026-11-15T10:00:00.000Z; it allowed 30 seconds between heartbeats
